_comment: Whitelist of mods for Legendary Deathworld, same shape as Factorio's mod-list.json (minus versions). A mod listed with enabled=true is enabled; anything listed false -- or absent entirely -- is written to mod-list.json with enabled=false (default-deny: Factorio would otherwise auto-enable unknown mods on startup). The generated mod-list.json itself is never committed -- regenerate it with tools/sync-mod-list.
